goalZh: 会和朋友一起网购:选颜色和尺码、问运费和到货时间、加入购物车、结账
canDoZh: 能和朋友一起在网上买东西:选颜色和尺码、看运费和到货时间、下单付款

newItems.noteZh: buy them online 在网上买;on 美式读 /ɑːn/。也能放在名词前:an online store 网店。
the same shoes 同一双鞋;same 前面一般加 the。a 读 /eɪ/,结尾 m 要闭上嘴。
free shipping 免运费;sh 是 /ʃ/,舌尖往后收、嘴唇向前突——读成 sipping 就成了“小口喝”。
Black is out of stock. 黑色缺货了;三个词连起来读,out of 的 t 读成轻快的 d:“ou-də-stock”。
网页按钮上的 Add to Cart;cart 是购物车,超市的手推车也叫 cart;ar 要卷舌。
go to checkout 去结账;重音在前 CHECK-out。超市的收银台也叫 checkout。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I really like these shoes, but they're fifty dollars.
lines.zh: (回到宿舍,磊又想起第 4 课那双运动鞋)我真的很喜欢这双鞋,可是要 50 美元。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Fifty? Buy them online, man. The same shoes are thirty percent off.
lines.zh: 50?在网上买呀,哥们儿。同一双鞋网上减 30%。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Wow, that's a good deal! How much is shipping?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: It's free shipping. They come in three days.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Great. Do they have them in black?

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: No, black is out of stock. Gray or white?
lines.zh: 没有,黑色的缺货了。要灰色还是白色?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Gray, please. In China, I wear a 42.
lines.zh: 灰色吧。在中国我穿 42 码。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: In the US, that's a size nine.

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: OK, size nine. Add to cart, then checkout.
lines.zh: 好,9 码。加入购物车,然后结账。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Wait! Are returns free? Shoes don't always fit.
lines.zh: 等等!退货免费吗?鞋子不一定合脚。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Let me see... Yes, free returns for thirty days.
lines.zh: 我看看……免费,三十天内都能退。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Cool. Now pay with your new bank card, man!
lines.zh: 好嘞。现在用你新办的银行卡付钱吧,哥们儿!

questions.prompt: 网上的同一双鞋怎么卖?
questions.explainZh: 伊森说 The same shoes are thirty percent off.(同一双鞋减 30%,也就是七折。)是 30%,不是 30 美元。

questions.prompt: 磊最后选了什么颜色、多大的鞋?
questions.explainZh: 黑色缺货了(black is out of stock),磊说 Gray, please.;他在中国穿 42 码,伊森说 In the US, that's a size nine.(在美国是 9 码。)

questions.prompt: 付款前,伊森提醒磊注意什么?为什么?
options: 退货免不免费,因为鞋子不一定合脚
运费多少,因为运费很贵
什么时候到货,因为周末要穿
questions.explainZh: 伊森说 Are returns free? Shoes don't always fit.(退货免费吗?鞋子不一定合脚。)

grammar.bodyZh: 网购页面上最常见的几个词:add to cart(加入购物车)、checkout(结账)、free shipping(免运费)、out of stock(缺货)、free returns(免费退货)。问运费说 How much is shipping?。问有没有某个颜色时,鞋是复数,要说 Do they have them in black?;一件外套就说 Do they have it in black?。发音:/ʃ/(shipping、shoes、T-shirt)和 /s/(sale、size、same)要分清。四川口音常把 sh 读成 s,发 /ʃ/ 时舌尖往后收、嘴唇向前突。

examples.text: How much is shipping? — It's free shipping.
Sorry, black is out of stock.
Add to cart, then go to checkout.
examples.zh: 加入购物车,然后去结账。

grammar.titleZh: in + 一段时间:多久以后
grammar.bodyZh: 说“多久以后”,用 in + 一段时间:They come in three days.(三天后到。)第 5 单元银行职员也说过 Your card comes in about a week.(你的卡大约一周后到)。in three days 是从现在算起“三天以后”。问“要花多长时间”用 How long does it take?,回答 It takes three days.。中文说“三天后”,时间在前;英语的 in 放在时间前面,不说 three days in。

examples.text: The next bus comes in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 下一班公交十分钟后来。

examples.text: How long does it take? — It takes three days.
